teaching_block_audit.check: Introduces a hypothetical everyday example without asserting a definition or conclusion.
Nearly identical readings under similar conditions illustrate repeatability, the relevant sense of consistency.
For repeated measurements of the same weight, a fixed five-pound bias preserves consistency while making the displayed weight inaccurate.
The surrounding example supplies similar measurement conditions; similarity across repetitions appropriately describes consistency.
Validity concerns whether measurements support their intended interpretation or use, not merely whether readings repeat.
Repeatability alone does not establish measurement of the intended construct; a hiring test can be consistent yet unsuitable for interpreting job performance.
